name: Livigno (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Livigno (a white cross on red and the Madonna on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Livigno, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Livigno arms — white cross on red and the Madonna on blue, crowned, within branches
